title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Sibling Billing Order and Sibling Discount
content:
Sibling discounts in the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program are worked out across the household's whole portfolio, separately for each billing month.

## Children counted

The children counted are the household's students whose Creek Kids Club enrollments receive a tuition charge for that billing month, meaning enrollments in status active or suspended for nonpayment on the posting date. An enrollment funded through Workforce Solutions Child Care Services is left out of the count when its plan does not apply the sibling discount to subsidy-funded enrollments.

## Billing order and discount

The counted children are ordered by the standard monthly tuition of each child's plan, highest first, before any rate-basis discount. Ties go to the earlier registration date, and then to the earlier start date.

| Sibling position | Who holds it | Sibling discount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | the first child in the billing order | none (full rate) |
| 2 | the second child | the second-child sibling discount |
| 3 | every third or later child | the third-and-later sibling discount |

A household with one counted child has no sibling discount. When an enrollment leaves the count, the positions change only from the next billing month posted.

## Figures by plan

| Plan | Second-child sibling discount | Third-and-later sibling discount | Sibling discount on a Workforce Solutions-funded enrollment |
|---|---|---|---|
| All six Creek Kids Club plans (After-School 2 Days, Before-School 5 Days, After-School 3 Days, After-School 5 Days, Before & After-School 5 Days, Pre-K Wraparound 5 Days) | 10 percent | 15 percent | does not apply |

## Worked order (hypothetical household)

Three children receive tuition charges in one billing month. Child A is on a plan with a hypothetical standard tuition of 300.00. Children B and C are each on plans of 200.00 (hypothetical). B registered earlier than C.

- A is position 1 and pays the full rate.
- B is position 2 and receives the 10 percent sibling discount.
- C is position 3 and receives the 15 percent sibling discount.

If C's enrollment were funded through Workforce Solutions Child Care Services, C would be left out of the count. A would still be position 1 and B position 2. If B then withdrew during that month, the positions would change only from the next billing month posted.
